note: NTRK1-3 fusion required (OR); ETV6 correctly kept out (IFS/CMN/SBC with ETV6 rearrangement - in practice ETV6-NTRK3, still an NTRK3 fusion).
KMT2A fusion or NPM1 mutation required of every phase (OR).
BCR-ABL1 required; T315I/V299L excluded ("Documented prior history of T315I or V299L").

CHIP-AML22 master protocol: FLT3 !SV comes from "Additional exclusion criteria for the induction randomization: Patients with FLT3-ITD/NPM1wt" - those patients go to the quizartinib sub-study instead, so excluding FLT3-ITD for everyone loses them.
RET mutation required (MTC).

PNOC022 (DMG): "Thalamic H3K27M DMG" is excluded in some cohorts only (site-based), but H3 K27M is published as excluded for everyone in all four H3 genes, which excludes nearly every DMG patient. The inclusion H3 genes were correctly kept out (cohort_specific); exclusion genes get no role check.

RET alteration required of every cohort, but phase 1 says "A RET gene alteration is not required initially. Once adequate PK exposure is achieved, evidence of RET gene alteration ... is required". Found by the gene-scope check (2026-10-02); the first reading had judged it correct.
MYC !SV stands for the Burkitt exclusion ("leukemia ... with FAB L3 morphology and/or a MYC translocation"); B-ALL with a MYC rearrangement is rare.
NTRK fusion required (HGG with NTRK fusion).
Ph+ excluded (BCR/ABL1 !SV); the high-risk genetic features correctly kept out as risk_group.

at least one of the following: a. CCNE1 amplification b. FBXW7 deleterious mutations c. Proprietary gene [PPP2R1A, per the conditions] deleterious mutations: PPP2R1A is not published, so those patients are lost.

SIOP-HRMB: the germline exclusion ("germline TP53, APC, PTCH1, SUFU, PALB2, BRCA2") is published as a tumour exclusion, which excludes the "somatic SHH-TP53 mutant tumours" the inclusion names as high-risk; MYCN amplification is excluded for everyone although only "Non-WNT/non-SHH Group 4 ... with MYCN amplification and no other high-risk factor" is excluded and MYC/MYCN-amplified tumours are an inclusion feature.
FIREFLY-1: Arms 2 and 3 take "activating BRAF mutation or RAF fusion" / "activating RAF fusion"; only BRAF is published, so RAF1 (CRAF) fusions are lost.

The VHR alterations (KMT2A::AFF1, TP53, TCF3-PBX1, TCF3::HLF) are one route; the others are MRD after SCT/CAR-T, insufficient remission before SCT, or a second SCT, and low hypodiploidy is a non-gene alternative in the same list. Requiring the genes loses every MRD-route patient.
FLT3 ITD/TKD required in both phases.
ROS1 or NTRK1-3 fusion required; ALK is in the title only, not in the criteria.
ALK aberration required (IHC enough for ALCL, so Any Variation is right).

REGOBONE: the CTIS eligibility text describes only the CIC-rearranged sarcoma cohort, so CIC SV follows the text; the registry conditions (osteosarcoma, Ewing, chondrosarcoma, chordoma) suggest closed cohorts.
Ph+/BCR-ABL ALL excluded.
ALK rearrangement or activating ALK mutation required of every cohort.
DAN-CART (also in audit 2): VHR genetics are one of several B-ALL routes (very early relapse, MRD, second relapse, relapse after HSCT) and B-NHL has none; the genes are required of everyone.
ALK+ ALCL as ALK SV (ALK+ ALCL is the NPM1::ALK fusion in nearly all cases).

EPILOGUE: "activating RAF alteration (e.g. KIAA1549::BRAF fusion, BRAF V600E mutation, RAF1-fusions)" published as exactly those three, so other BRAF fusions and non-V600E BRAF mutations are lost. The NF-1 diagnosis exclusion as NF1 !Any Variation also excludes somatic NF1 (germline published as tumour).
COGNITO-MB: "SHH-activated MB" (a molecular subgroup) published as SHH Any Variation; SHH-MB is driven by PTCH1/SUFU/SMO, not SHH, so nearly every eligible patient is lost.
Ph+ (BCR::ABL1) ALL excluded.

CRLF2/JAK2/EPOR lesions required, as written; "or CRLF2 expression on leukemic cells' surface" is a non-genomic alternative that CRLF2 Any Variation only catches if the record carries the rearrangement.
MET amplification required.
EWSR1::WT1 required for DSRCT.
KMT2A-r, NUP98-r or NPM1-mut, as written; the extra NPM1 !SV has no textual basis but excludes no eligible patient (MLL-PTD exclusion not written: minor over-match).
Ph+ (ABL1 SV) or ABL-class Ph-like (ABL1/ABL2 SV); T315I allowed.
Ph+ CML: BCR SV required and ABL1 !Structural Variation published (from the exclusion "BCR::ABL mutation with known resistance"); every Ph+ CML carries the BCR::ABL1 fusion, so nobody can match.

AIEOP-BFM ALL 2025: "Patients < 1 year of age with KMT2A-rearranged B-ALL if enrollment in a study specifically designed for these patients is possible" published as KMT2A !SV for everyone, so every KMT2A-r ALL patient over 1 year is lost.
REVEAL-ND: the FLT3 ITD exclusion (which applies to all) is published as FLT3 !Structural Variation; ITD is recorded as a mutation, so FLT3-ITD patients still match (over-match only).
TRIDENT-1: ALK, ROS1, NTRK1-3 rearrangement (phase 1) and ROS1 or NTRK1-3 fusion (phase 2) published as ROS1 only, so NTRK fusion patients are lost.

TNBC ... OR germline BRCA mutation positive, HER2 negative: BRCA1/2 are required of everyone, so TNBC without gBRCA is lost; ER and HER2 negativity (expression) are written as ESR1/ERBB2 !Any Variation.
IDH2 R140/R172 required; the high-risk MDS genes correctly dropped as alternative_route.
known MYC translocation associated with mature (Burkitt) B-cell ALL, regardless of blast immunophenotype excluded as MYC !SV; it applies to everyone.
LGG without a BRAFV600E mutation published as BRAF !Mutation, so LGG with a non-V600E BRAF mutation is lost; NF1 correctly kept out as germline.
H3 K27M/K27I required (H3-3A/B, H3C2/C3, Any Variation: slightly wide, over-match only).
HEY1::NCOA2 required for mesenchymal chondrosarcoma.

CLL/SLL arm: del(17p)/TP53 mutation is one example of iwCLL high-risk features ("such as primary resistance ... or progression <3 years ... or del(17p)/TP53"), published as required, so high-risk CLL without TP53 is lost.

CDK4/6 activation features applies to the ovarian cohort and "lack of CCNE amplification or RB loss" to the endometrial cohort; all four genes are published together, so endometrial patients need a CDK4/6 alteration and are lost.
PML::RARA required (partner unverified, so the PML SV alone is applied).
KMT2A, NPM1, NUP98 or NUP214 alterations required.
CCNE1 amplification, FBXW7 or PPP2R1A deleterious mutation, as written (the same programme as 2023-510063-35-00, where PPP2R1A was hidden as "proprietary gene").
PRC2 loss MPNST (e.g. IHC loss of H3K27me2/me3 and/or inactivating mutations in EED, SUZ12, EZH2): the IHC route is lost, and most PRC2-loss MPNST are diagnosed by H3K27me3 IHC.
EWSR1::FLI1 (Ewing, phase 2) required of everyone, so the phase 1 recurrent non-CNS solid tumours are lost; "or other EWS rearrangement" (EWSR1::ERG) is lost too.

without BRAF V600 or IDH1 mutations published as BRAF !Mutation, losing HGG with non-V600 BRAF mutations; the H3 K27M-wild-type stratum's exclusion omits H3-3A (the commonest K27M gene), an over-match.
ARROS-1: "known oncogenic driver alteration other than ROS1" published as ROS1 !Any Variation at step level, while every arm requires ROS1 SV; nobody can match.
CURATE: "MMRd, confirmed by either loss of MSH2/MSH6/MLH1/PMS2 by IHC OR loss-of-function mutation of MMR gene(s)": the IHC route is lost (MMR mutations required).
NUTM1 SV (the NUT carcinoma expansion cohort) required of everyone; the dose-escalation cohort takes any metastatic solid tumour, including breast cancer, and is lost.
Arm 2b "no known EGFR or ALK positive tumor mutations": ALK published as !Mutation, so ALK-fusion NSCLC still matches (over-match only); scoped to the right arm.
H3 K27M DMG: H3 genes required.
IDH1 or IDH2 mutation required.
BRAF mutation will be excluded applies to everyone; Any Variation also excludes rare BRAF fusions in GBM.
HER2-positive ... IHC 3+ or SISH+ (or FISH) ... or significant overexpression of HER2 protein: ERBB2 amplification required, so IHC 3+ and proteomic-only HER2-positive patients are lost.
NTRK1-3 fusion required.
MET exon 14 skipping required; the other drivers correctly dropped as examples.
TP53-mutated myeloid malignancy (the title's "TP53+") required.
IMPACT: "Group A patients with medulloblastoma of the SHH subtype" (a molecular subgroup) published as SHH !Any Variation; SHH-MB rarely carries an SHH variant, so they still match (over-match only).
APL (PML::RARA) excluded; JMML genes correctly dropped as alternative routes.
FLT3-ITD required as FLT3 Structural Variation; an ITD is recorded as a mutation (in-frame insertion), so FLT3-ITD+ patients do not match. NPM1 wild type correctly written as NPM1 !Any Variation.

Identified mutation in MAPK pathway genes, including but not limited to ARAF, BRAF ... NF1 (for primary cohort; no mutation needed for exploratory cohort): required of everyone, so the exploratory cohort is lost, and "not limited to" makes the list examples.

RRD HGG "by tumor IHC showing functional loss of MMR gene expression ... or prior germline testing confirming CMMRD or Lynch": tumour MMR variants are required, so IHC-only and germline-only patients are lost.
IDH1-mutated AML required.

NF1 or KIAA1549::BRAF pLGG, as written; NF1 can be "based on clinical NIH criteria" (no tumour variant) and the V600E exclusion is widened to BRAF !Mutation (patients eligible by NF1 with a non-V600E BRAF mutation are rare).
RUNX1::RUNX1T1 required; APL (PML::RARA) and BCR::ABL1 AML excluded, as written.
DNAJB1::PRKACA required.

MYC + BCL2/BCL6 rearrangement ("double or triple hit" HGBL) is one entity in a list of eligible B-cell lymphomas, and the trial also takes myeloma and B-ALL; the rearrangements are required of everyone.
ALK+ ALCL required; ALK-negative ALCL excluded.

ETP-ALL and "near-ETP-ALL" are defined by immunophenotype; "T-ALL with myeloid mutations" is the third route. The mutations are required of everyone, and ASXL2, SF3B1, TET2, BCOR, BCORL1 from the same list are missing.
MET amplification required.
NPM1 mutation required.
ML-DS: GATA1 mutation (somatic) required with AML/MDS.
one or more of the following mutations: H3.3K27M, H3.1K27M, H3.3G34R, BRAF V600E, PIK3CA H1047R, IDH1 R132H, or EGFRvIII, all published as alternatives.

MSS or pMMR ... no evidence of dMMR/MSI-H status or POLE ultramutated phenotype published as !Any Variation on MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2/POLE, so an MSS tumour with any variant in those genes (a VUS, a passenger mutation) is lost.
EWSR1::WT1 required for DSRCT.
NPM1c, KMT2A or NUP98 translocation required.

Intermediate-risk RMS enrols by "FOXO1 fusion status" for both fusion-negative (stage 2/3 group III; stage 4 <10 y) and fusion-positive patients; FOXO1 SV is required of everyone, so every fusion-negative patient is lost.
Ph+ (BCR::ABL1) ALL excluded.
